Diamond Grid

Piece Details

View larger artwork (new tab)

  • MediumMicron pen & graphite pencil
  • Year2024
  • CategoryMixed-media
  • Notes14" x 16" on drawing paper

Overview

In this piece, I tried to make a subtle illusion with a diamond grid which is thicker toward the center and more narrow toward the borders.

Process / Additional Notes

I used an architect ruler to carefully place the location of each diamond stud. I shaded one side of each diamond direction with micron pen and graphite pencil.
